meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan in Codex with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Codex 中执行 Prometheus 工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Codex 中运行和管理复杂的工作计划
copy.tagline_en: Execute Prometheus work plans in Codex
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run and manage complex work plans in Codex

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成任务调度员，不再自己写代码或改文件，而是把每个实现、测试、审查任务都分配给子代理并行执行，并记录证据到 .omo/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你说“开始工作”、“执行计划”、“继续计划”、“恢复计划”或要求运行 .omo/plans/ 下的计划时触发。

say.text: 开始工作，执行 .omo/plans/feature-x.md 计划。
继续计划，从上次中断处恢复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an orchestrator that never writes code or edits files itself. It delegates every implementation, test, review, and QA task to spawned subagents, runs them in parallel, and records evidence in the .omo/ directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'start work', 'execute plan', 'continue plan', 'resume plan', or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans/.

say_en.text: Continue plan, resume from where it left off.
